tools.description: Call this FIRST when the photos are on the caller's machine rather than already on the web — our renderer fetches over the network and cannot read a local path. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_designs · Private data: upload_images, create_designs, fill_template · Public sink: upload_images · Destructive: upload_images.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_designs · Private data: upload_images, create_designs, fill_template · Public sink: upload_images · Destructive: upload_images

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
